newsitem.title: CANADA: Bema assay results widen Cerro Casale zone.
newsitem.headline: Bema assay results widen Cerro Casale zone.

text.p: Bema Gold Corp and Arizona Star Resource Corp said on Thursday additional assay results from deep diamond drilling on the Cerro Casale deposit in northern Chile indicate a substantial increase in the width of the main porphyry zone.

Bema said diamond drill hole 30 indicates an increase in the width of the main zone, which was previously estimated at a minimum 850 metres long by 300 metres wide by 750 metres deep. It said the bottom of the hole 30 is 350 metres southwest of the southern boundary of the main porphyry zone.
The hole was drilled from the centre of the main zone at a minus 50 degree dip to the southwest to a total depth of 800 metres.

It said hole 29 was drilled from the south on the opposite side of the mountain through porpylitic altered porphyry and the bottom 80 metres of the hole is in potassically altered porphyry mineralization.
The main porphyry zone remains open to the south, west, northeast and at depth, Bema said.
Assay results from holes 31, 32 and 33 will be released when available and drilling is ongoing.
Bema is the manager and largest shareholder of Arizona Star. Cerro Casale is 51 percent owned by Arizona and 49 percent by Bema.
